documents.title: Generative AI at ESF
documents.stance_why: Coder A said encourage, coder B delegates. The page sets no rule on coursework and hands nothing to instructors, so delegates (passing the decision on) does not fit. It welcomes AI: it lists institution-provided tools for 'Students, Faculty, and Staff', says 'Use Claude Chat for every day work', and tells readers to 'Take', 'Watch' and 'Check out' AI learning resources, with only a soft data rule ('recommended'). That is encouragement, so encourage.
documents.summary: A short IT-hosted page that frames generative AI as changing work and study, asks users to review and own AI output, and recommends entering ESF data only in approved tools. It lists provided tools (Copilot, Gemini, Adobe Express, Claude, Mentor.AI) and AI-literacy resources. It has no teaching, integrity, or disclosure policy.
